text: I want to use numbers to check everyday problems.
A library cart carries 18 books on three equal shelves. How many books are on each shelf? Explain the calculation.

lesson.declared_goal: Use quantitative reasoning in everyday situations
lesson.exercise: A library cart carries 18 books on three equal shelves. How many books are on each shelf? Explain the calculation.
outline: Apply it to a different setting

rubric.criterion: Divide the total by the number of equal shelves and report six books per shelf.
